calls.description: 修正 OOXML 公式文本并保留缓存值
calls.command:

import zipfile, os, re
p = r'E:\project\WorkPivot\tmp\rea-office-test\rea-excel-edit.xlsx'
zin = zipfile.ZipFile(p, 'r')
infos = zin.infolist()
data = {i.filename: zin.read(i.filename) for i in infos}
zin.close()

target = [n for n in data if n.startswith('xl/worksheets/sheet')][0]
xml = data[target].decode('utf-8')
before = re.findall(r'<f[^>]*>(.*?)</f>', xml, re.S)
new_xml, cnt = re.subn(r'(<f[^>]*>)=', r'\1', xml)
after = re.findall(r'<f[^>]*>(.*?)</f>', new_xml, re.S)
print('target:', target)
print('before:', before)
print('after :', after, '| replacements:', cnt)
data[target] = new_xml.encode('utf-8')

tmp = p + '.tmp'
zout = zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, 'w')
for i in infos:
    d = data[i.filename]
    zi = zipfile.ZipInfo(i.filename, date_time=i.date_time)
    zi.compress_type = i.compress_type
    zi.external_attr = i.external_attr
    zi.create_system = i.create_system
    zout.writestr(zi, d)
zout.close()
os.replace(tmp, p)
print('written back to', p)
" 2>&1
